subject: prd/docgate
statement: When constructing a mismatch key, docgate shall encode each compared scalar as canonical JSON: a projected cell is the exact UTF-8 string returned after the ledger's line-ending/trailing-line-space normalization plus registered table decoding (outer delimiters removed and leading/trailing cell whitespace trimmed), a source-map string is its exact decoded JSON string, a boolean is literal `true` or `false`, and absence is `null`; it shall apply no further case folding, Unicode normalization, internal-whitespace folding, Markdown-markup normalization, or empty/absent equivalence.
rationale: an undefined “canonical value” lets two implementations disagree on whether historical debt changed
fit_criterion: CRLF versus LF, trailing line whitespace, and delimiter-adjacent whitespace normalize green; case change, internal whitespace change, composed versus decomposed Unicode, Markdown markup change, and empty string versus absent are each red; the baseline golden encodes absence as JSON `null`
